## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND signal a mild risk-on tilt while HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) and LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND plus sector contraction (XLY_XLP ↓ falling) keep the market balanced.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND show deteriorating credit signals. Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, but Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) ↑ rising with SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Yield pressure: TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND indicates higher yields; yield curve level ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Dollar firm (Level ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND) keeps financial conditions mixed and broadly neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND. Financials and cyclicals showing weakness on breadth with Financials (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND — Style: Growth/momentum leadership but narrow.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND while China lags: FXI (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND and Europe showing softness (Europe vs US → flat | BELOW TREND). EM mixed with EEM (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND but China tech underperformance remains.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation firm: IBIT (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +5.82%) ABOVE TREND. Small caps weak: IWM (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND — speculative tape healthy but narrow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Copper steady: CPER (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND; gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND. Energy bifurcated with Brent (BNO 1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak on sector breadth and XLE (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND, but oil futures show longer-run strength (BNO CORRECTION). Natural gas strength (UNG ABOVE TREND) is a near-term offset.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple commodity ETFs (BNO, USO, UGA) in CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M strength — watch for mean reversion; credit ETFs HYG/LQD both BELOW TREND reinforce caution.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor measured exposure to tech/momentum (XLK, QQQ) while monitoring credit stress and narrow breadth; reduce exposure to long-duration bonds (TLT) given rising yields. Keep allocations flexible — NEUTRAL posture with selective risk-taking.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/WATCH: GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND and crude (BNO 1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) CORRECTION — watch for volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND ~20 = complacency watch; HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) vs LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND ~0.80 marks credit health. XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) vs Financials (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -5.56%) ratio (~Tech lead) is a pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and momentum showing strength: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and QQQ (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk is rising credit stress with HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) and LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND amid narrow breadth that could reverse the current leadership.
